questions.q: Where do users find the Email Templates object without any special setup?
options: The App Launcher search box — it's a standard Item
It must be added as a custom tab first by an admin
Only inside the Setup menu, never in the main app
It only appears after Email-to-Case is enabled
questions.explain: Email Templates is a standard object — searching for 'template' in the App Launcher surfaces it under Items with no configuration required.

questions.q: What permission turns on the modern drag-and-drop Email Template Builder for a user?
options: Customize Application
Access drag-and-drop content builder, enabled in a permission set's System Permissions
View Setup and Configuration
Manage Email Templates, assigned on a profile's object permissions
questions.explain: The Lightning builder is gated behind the 'Access drag-and-drop content builder' system permission — without it, users only see the older plain template editor.

questions.q: What does the Related Entity Type field on a new Email Template control?
options: Which users can see the template in list views
Whether the template uses the Lightning builder or the classic editor
The object merge fields in the template resolve against
The letterhead's logo and header color
questions.explain: Related Entity Type (Contact, Lead, Opportunity, a custom object, or None) determines which record's fields a template's merge fields can pull data from.

questions.q: What is the practical difference between a letterhead and a template?
options: A letterhead is the reusable branding shell (logo, header/footer, colors); a template is a specific email that applies a letterhead and adds its own subject and body
There is no difference — the terms are interchangeable in Salesforce
A letterhead only works in Salesforce Classic, never in Lightning
A template can only use one letterhead ever, with no way to change it later
questions.explain: Separating the reusable branding (letterhead) from the specific email content (template) means updating the letterhead once updates every template built on it.

questions.q: Besides manually sending an email from a record, where else does a finished Email Template commonly get used?
options: Nowhere else — templates can only be sent manually from a record
Only inside Data Loader import jobs
Only as the welcome message on the Salesforce login page
Email Alerts fired by workflow rules, processes, or Flow, and Approval Process notifications
questions.explain: A template built once can back automated Email Alerts (workflow/process/Flow-triggered) and Approval Process notifications, not just manual sends.
